001package com.fs.starfarer.api;
002
003import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.FocusManagerAPI;
010
011 /**
012 * The primary way to access most of the game's state (fleets, stars, ships, people, etc) and many useful classes for creating and modifying state.
013 *
014 * @author Alex Mosolov
015 *
016 * Copyright 2012 Fractal Softworks, LLC
017 */
018public class Global {
019        
020        public static boolean CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE = false;
021        
022        public static boolean LOADING_SAVE = false;
023        
024        
025        private static FocusManagerAPI focusManagerAPI;
026        private static SettingsAPI settingsAPI;
027        private static SectorAPI sectorAPI;
028        private static FactoryAPI factory;
029        private static SoundPlayerAPI soundPlayer;
030        private static CombatEngineAPI combatEngine;
031        
032        
033        public static GameState getCurrentState() {
034                return settingsAPI.getCurrentState();
035        }
036
037        /**
038         * Creates a new {@link Logger} that will add the given class to all log messages it produces.
039         * <pre>
040         * {@code
041         *  class MyClass {
042         *    Logger log = Global.getLogger(MyClass.class);
043         *
044         *    void myMethod() {
045         *      log.info("Hello, world!");
046         *    }
047         *  }
048         *}
049         * </pre>
050         *
051         * @param c the class to add to the log messages
052         */
053        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
054        public static Logger getLogger(Class c) {
055                Logger log = Logger.getLogger(c);
056                return log;
057        }
058        
059        
060        public static FocusManagerAPI getFocusManager() {
061                return focusManagerAPI;
062        }
063
064        public static void setFocusManager(FocusManagerAPI focusManagerAPI) {
065                Global.focusManagerAPI = focusManagerAPI;
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * Used to create fleets, markets, cargo, crew compositions, jump points, progress indicators,
070         * memory objects, persons, officer data, battles, cargo stacks, communication messages, fleet stubs,
071         * and fleet AI, along with various orbit configurations and fleet members.
072         *
073         * Should only be used in the campaign.
074         */
075        public static FactoryAPI getFactory() {
076                return factory;
077        }
078
079        public static void setFactory(FactoryAPI factory) {
080                Global.factory = factory;
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * Gets the {@link SoundPlayerAPI}, which is used to play sound effects and music.
085         */
086        public static SoundPlayerAPI getSoundPlayer() {
087                return soundPlayer;
088        }
089
090        public static void setSoundPlayer(SoundPlayerAPI sound) {
091                Global.soundPlayer = sound;
092        }
093
094        /**
095         * Gets the {@link SettingsAPI}, which contains access to current settings and many useful utility methods.
096         */
097        @NotNull
098        public static SettingsAPI getSettings() {
099                return settingsAPI;
100        }
101
102        public static void setSettings(SettingsAPI api) {
103                Global.settingsAPI = api;
104        }
105
106        /**
107         * Gets the currently loaded save game's {@link SectorAPI}, which contains all {@link com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI}s,
108         * {@link com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetAPI}s, the sectory {@link com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI}, and more.
109         * <p>
110         * On the main menu, this may or may not be null.
111         */
112        @Nullable
113        public static SectorAPI getSector() {
114                return sectorAPI;
115        }
116
117        /**
118         * Gets the {@link CombatEngineAPI}, which is typically active in combat, on the main menu, and on the refit screen.
119         * Mainly used to get info about and modify battles.
120         */
121        public static CombatEngineAPI getCombatEngine() {
122                return combatEngine;
123        }
124
125        public static void setCombatEngine(CombatEngineAPI combatEngine) {
126                Global.combatEngine = combatEngine;
127        }
128
129        public static void setSector(SectorAPI api) {
130                Global.sectorAPI = api;
131        }
132
133        /**
134         * @deprecated use {@link #getSettings()} instead
135         */
136        @Deprecated
137        public static SettingsAPI getSettingsAPI() {
138                return settingsAPI;
139        }
140
141        /**
142         * @deprecated use {@link #getSector()} instead
143         */
144        @Deprecated
145        public static SectorAPI getSectorAPI() {
146                return sectorAPI;
147        }
148}
